subject.title: test(ui): align new-session e2e with path routes and startup transcript

question: Should this protected test-only PR land now while the focused E2E command intentionally retains two failures for the separately open product-regression report?
rationale: The patch restores two stale test expectations, but accepting a merged test surface that still fails in two known scenarios is a maintainer-owned release and test-policy choice rather than a mechanical code judgment.

options.title: Land as regression coverage
options.body: Accept the two remaining failures as deliberate signals for the open product fixes and merge this narrow alignment after visible after-fix proof is added.

options.title: Bundle with product fixes
options.body: Hold this branch until the fixes for the remaining scenarios are ready, then land a focused suite that is green end to end.
